notes.title: Shashlik's demo is out now!
notes.content:
Greetings to you. On this most beautiful day, the kebab demo has been released. I hope you like it and will wait for the full version. 
[h1]About the demo's shortcomings:[/h1]
You may not like it for some reasons: lack of multiplayer - will be in full version, process of marinade creation - will be improved in full version, optimization - I will explain later. Also not without bugs, which I can not fix :(
[h1]About future plans:[/h1]
After n time I will publish in [url=https://discord.gg/PezY53Rvy3]discord server[/url], [url=https://t.me/SHASHLIK_GAME]telegram[/url] and in steam full roadmap without dates. In a nutshell, porting the game to unity. This event will lead to a very big change in mechanics(no).
[h1]About feedback:[/h1]
After playing the demo, you can leave feedback at this link:
https://forms.gle/vUMnnFMSMi7Fc8s49

Ask questions below or in discord, I'll try to answer them all.
